decisive_items: 2 × 1.5 × 0.5-cm tan to brown, rubbery specimen consisted of cartilage
Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100 and negative for KI-67. Low cellularity and low MIB-1 proliferation index
expansion of the fallopian canal distal to the second genu of the facial nerve, erosion of the posterior external auditory canal, and expansion of the stylomastoid foramen
response.rationale: Cartilaginous tumor with pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, S100 positivity, low proliferation, and destructive temporal bone/fallopian canal imaging is most consistent with low-grade chondrosarcoma; schwannoma lacks cartilaginous/myxochondroid matrix and syringoma does not produce this erosive mastoid/fallopian canal picture.

rejected.why: Chondroid syringoma is a benign cutaneous adnexal tumor and does not explain erosive fallopian canal/stylomastoid foramen expansion or mastoid location.
Facial nerve schwannoma fits location/imaging and S100 positivity, but gross/microscopic cartilage and myxochondroid matrix are not schwannoma features.
